title: Mr. Weinstein and Professor Longhair
summary: Weinstein is a good man in the clique who took over Professor Longhair's business.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: But he is basically a good man. And you can go there and get any information you want. But I do know one thing. He's just in part of the thing. He's part of the clique. And there ain't nothing much he can do. But what he did for Professor Longhair, this is when I really found out that he's a good man. You see, Professor Longhair was taken. The Fess was taken. And when Mr. Weinstein found out about it, and he took over Fess's business, that's why whatever Professor Longhair had right now today is because of Mr. Weinstein. Nobody else but him. Because he took over. And he tell me, you know what he tell me? He said, tell me, man, let me tell you something. He said, man, y'all go down and sign all them papers and have all them crooks taking all your money and things. He said, look, when you get a piece of paper, tell me what you do. He said, if you have something and you don't quite understand, he said, look, just find time to come on down here. He said, let me look over for you. And this is what, and he emphasized it all the time, but I still don't do it. But basically a good man, that's all.
